panels.title: Sold
panels.description: Confirmed sold policies for the selected time range and filters.

panels.title: Conversion
panels.description: Sold divided by SALE-disposition calls in the current selection.

panels.title: Transfers
panels.description: SALE-disposition calls that are not marked sold.

panels.title: 20+ minute
panels.description: SALE calls manually marked as reaching 20+ minutes.

panels.title: 30+ minute
panels.description: SALE calls manually marked as reaching 30+ minutes.

panels.title: Missing preset
panels.description: SALE calls whose client/preset lookup did not resolve.

panels.title: 20+ → Sold
panels.description: Share of 20+ minute calls that became sold policies.

panels.title: 30+ → Sold
panels.description: Share of 30+ minute calls that became sold policies.

panels.title: 20+ share
panels.description: Share of SALE calls that reached 20+ minutes.

panels.title: 30+ share
panels.description: Share of SALE calls that reached 30+ minutes.

panels.title: Below 20 min
panels.description: Share of SALE calls that did not reach the 20+ minute mark.

panels.title: Stale calls
panels.description: Provisional calls that exceeded the two-hour Start/Dispo lifecycle window.

panels.title: Sales movement over time
panels.description: See how sold, transfers and longer calls are moving through the selected range. Hover any point for exact values.

panels.title: Selected-range outcome mix
panels.description: A compact comparison of the main volumes for the current filters. This is not a funnel; categories can overlap.

panels.title: Top sellers
panels.description: Sold policies by agent, already ranked by sold count. Use this as the quick motivational view; the full leaderboard is beside it.

panels.title: Agent leaderboard
panels.description: Detailed agent comparison for the same filters. Sold is intentionally first and the table defaults to highest sold count.

panels.title: Team performance
panels.description: Compare teams and team leaders without leaving the dashboard.

panels.title: Project performance
panels.description: Compare selected projects. The Project filter above supports selecting several projects at once.

panels.title: Client / preset performance
panels.description: See which client/preset groups are converting and where unresolved preset data exists.

panels.title: Sold in selected time range
panels.description: Final sold count for exactly the date/time, Projects, Team and Client/Preset filters selected above.

title: CallLens Sales Performance
description: Team-facing sales performance dashboard. Starts on today, puts Sold first, and keeps every view synchronized with the native Grafana filters.
